title: Context Atlas config
description: Every key is optional. Sizes are approximate tokens: chars_per_token Unicode code points each.

max_tokens.description: A chunk is closed before it grows past this.

min_tokens.description: A chunk is not closed for size below this, and a section is only split by topic above it.

overlap_tokens.description: How much of the previous chunk a chunk repeats, within one section and not at a topic change.

topic_min_tokens.description: No piece cut at a topic change is smaller than this.

split_long_paragraph_at.description: A paragraph longer than this is split between sentences.

chars_per_token.description: Unicode code points counted as one token.

seam_threshold.description: A seam whose two sides belong together less than this is worth cutting.

refers_back_weight.description: The share of a seam's togetherness taken from whether the second side depends on the first; the rest is whether it continues the subject.

refers_back_protect.description: A seam whose second side depends on the first at least this much is never cut.

snippet_chars.description: How much of each side of a seam Jev is shown.

batch_size.description: Seams per Jev request; each seam asks two questions.

max_pairs.description: Seams asked about per document at most; the rest are not cut by topic.

rank_threshold.description: A passage scoring below this is left out of the ranking.

passage_chars.description: How much of each passage Jev is shown when ranking.

cross_check.description: Also ask which single passage answers best, and put it first.

cross_check_rescue.description: Return the cross-check's pick even when no passage reached rank_threshold.

conversation_replies.description: Ask Jev which earlier message a conversation turn replies to when the source does not say. Off, only source reply_to links are kept.

conversation_outcomes.description: Ask Jev which conversation messages record an outcome and what each settles (decides links).

conversation_corrections.description: Ask Jev which conversation messages correct an earlier one (corrects links).

nearest_reserved.description: At retrieval, places among the first 9 candidates kept for the caller's top vector hits that fusion ranks lower; above 9 counts as 9, and 0 leaves the fused order.
